Emma (Partnerships): heads up — EdgeScale reported a spike of 403s on our incremental-usage webhook after they rotated their signing key last night. Also saw dupes when they retried. Can we triage?
Raj (Backend): I pulled logs: ~12k rejects between 23:14-23:40 UTC, then a second wave when partner retried with new batch ids. They rotated keys but didn't send the old signature header in retries.
Olivia (SI): they rely on client batch_id dedupe. When partner retries with a new batch_id we treat as new. We should add server-side idempotency or accept previous signatures during rotation.
EdgeScale Ops: we did a key swap as per our rotation plan. We can re-enable the old key for a short window but need to coordinate. Which header do you validate?
Raj (Backend): we validate X-ES-Signature (sha256). Example header: `X-ES-Signature: sha256=5a3f...`
Raj (Backend): verification pseudo:
```
// pseudo
signed = HMAC_SHA256(key, body)
if header != "sha256=" + hex(signed): reject
```
Raj (Backend): proposal: support a keyring so we accept both current and previous key for a configurable grace period. Also canonicalize idempotency to `batch_id|device_id|day_floor` to reduce dupes from retries.
Michael (Billing): need to prevent billing duplicates. We should flag ingested events that match our dedupe key and run a credits/backfill if duplicates already invoiced. I'll draft an audit + credit run plan.
Sasha (Security): accepting an old key for some days is OK if we log and alert. Limit to single previous key and TTL of 7 days max; require rotation audit event from partner. Also validate algorithm stays sha256.
Olivia (SI): can we get a staged test? Partner can send a batch signed with both keys to our staging endpoint and we run the same retry patterns. I can give them a replay URL.
webhook-bot: ALERT automated: signature-mismatch >= 500 in last hour for endpoint /hooks/incremental-usage
Emma (Partnerships): action list: @Raj implement dual-key acceptance + idempotency policy in staging by EOD tomorrow; @Michael prepare reconciliation/credit playbook; @Olivia coordinate partner tests; @Sasha review security constraints. EdgeScale Ops please confirm rollback window.
EdgeScale Ops: we can re-enable old key for 36h (not 72h). we'll also enable a monotonic batch_id option from our side to help dedupe.
Raj (Backend): I'll post the config diff and a minimal example for ops. Example config snippet:
```
{
  "webhook": {
    "accepted_signing_keys": ["espub_v2_current", "espub_v2_previous"],
    "idempotency_strategy": "batch_id|device_id|day"
  }
}
```
Raj (Backend): query to surface potential duplicates: `SELECT count(*) FROM ingests WHERE dedupe_key = $key GROUP BY ingestion_time` — will run nightly de-dupe job.
Michael (Billing): if duplicates were billed already we will run a one-off credit job and notify finance + account manager. I'll include rollback timestamps in the ticket.
Sasha (Security): please tag audit log events with `key_rotation` and include partner-provided rotation-id. I'll review the staging traffic once Olivia shares it.
Emma (Partnerships): awesome. I'll set a 30-min sync at 14:00 UTC to finalize timing and signoffs. :calendar: If anyone sees urgent escalations before then ping me.
EdgeScale Ops: thanks — will standby and coordinate rollback if needed.
Olivia (SI): I'll DM partner the staging webhook and test plan.
Raj (Backend): updated runbook link: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/webhooks#key-rotation> — adding steps for dual-key acceptance and dedupe backfill.
Emma (Partnerships): great work team. We'll reconvene after the staging run. :thumbsup:
